title: Landed: the critic looked at 60 pages and found six real problems

text: It shot 60 recent pages at phone and desktop width, the ten busiest at 3440 too, looked at all 130 pictures, and wrote down only what it could measure. 39 pages are clean. The six, worst first: three links in my own report lead to pages that do not exist; the Panel demo opens its own drawer over its own tabs, so Files reads as FILE; a tab strip with no scroll cue cuts a tab off against the title, the UX page with its twelve tabs overflows by 81 px; eight moved-page stubs leave about 90 percent of a tall column blank; the imagine home leaves 54 percent of a 3440 screen as flat gray; and three Page doc pages list the same 13 names twice, in the sidebar and in their own rail. Each has a cropped picture, the cause with file and line, and the smallest fix. The fixes start as soon as two of the six agents now working have landed; I am keeping fewer hands in the live site after the outage.
